en: Abu Hanifa Ahmad ibn Dawud al-Dinawari
tr: Ebû Hanîfe Ahmed b. Dâvûd ed-Dînaverî
ar: أبو حنيفة أحمد بن داود الدينوري

description.tr: Arap botaniğinin babası; 637 bitkiyi büyüme evreleri, yaşam alanları ve tarımsal uygulamalarıyla tanımladı || Botanik, astronomi, matematik ve tarih üzerine yazan çok yönlü alim || [Tarih notu] 6 ciltlik Kitâbü'n-Nebât'ın sadece 3. ve 5. ciltleri günümüze ulaştı
description.en: Father of Arabic botany; described 637 plants with growth phases, habitats, and agricultural applications || Polymath who wrote on botany, astronomy, mathematics, and history; his plant book is the largest pre-modern botanical work in Arabic || [Historiographical note] Only volumes 3 and 5 of his 6-volume Kitab al-Nabat survive; reconstructed from quotations
description.ar: أبو النبات العربي || عالم موسوعي كتب في النبات والفلك والرياضيات والتاريخ || [Historiographical note] لم ينجُ من كتاب النبات إلا المجلدان الثالث والخامس
